spans.s:
f. (-स्त्री)
A woman or female in general.
E.
स्त्यै to sound, ड्रट् Uṇādi aff., ङीप् fem. aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Attendance on women, or the women's apartments.
2 The business of women.
E.
स्त्री, and कार्थ्य business.

n. (-रं)
Mother's milk.
E.
स्त्री, and क्षीर milk.

f. (-वी)
A milch-cow.
E.
स्त्री a female, गो a cow, and ङीप् aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
A woman's murderer.
E.
स्त्री, and घ्न who kills.

m. (-षः)
Dawn, daybreak.
E.
स्त्री a woman, and घोष sound.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Pleasing or delightful to the female sex.
m. (-री)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
E.
स्त्री a woman, चित्त heart or mind, हारिन् what takes.

n. (-ह्नं)
The vulva.
E.
स्त्री a female, and चिह्न mark.

m. (-रः)
A libertine.
E.
स्त्री a woman, and चौर a thief.

f. (-नी)
The mother of a daughter.
E.
स्त्री, and जननी mother.

m. (-तः)
A henpecked husband.
E.
स्त्री a woman or wife, and जित overcome.

f. (-ता)
Womanhood, feminineness.
E.
स्त्री a woman, तल् aff.; also with त्व, aff. स्त्रीत्व n. (-त्वं).

n. (-नं)
Woman's separate property, which is held to be of six kinds: 1. Adhyagnikam, what is given before the sacrificial fire; 2. Adhyāvāhanikam, what is presented during the bridal procession; 3. Ādhivedanikam, what is given on her husband's marrying another wife; 4. Prītidattam, what is given through affection; 5. Śulkam, her dower allowed or perquisites made during marriage; 6. Anvādheyam, a gift from her own or husband's relatives after marriage. Other varieties are enumerated, as the pitṛ, mātṛ, suta, bhrātṛ dattam, what is given by her parents, son, or brother; bandhu dattam, what is given by her kindred; and some enumerate acceptance generally, and inheritance, amongst a woman's titles to property.
E.
स्त्री, धन wealth.

m. (-र्म्मः)
1 Duty of woman.
2 The menstrual excretion.
E.
स्त्री a woman, and धर्म्म peculiar property.

n. (-गं)
Laws or institutes concerning women.
E.
स्त्रीधर्म्म, and योग application.

f. (-णी)
A woman during menstruation.
E.
स्त्रीधर्म्म menstruation, इनि and ङीप् affs.

m. (-वः)
A man, a male.
E.
स्त्री a woman, and धव a husband.

n. (-नं)
A woman's peculiar province or domestic duty, housewifery.
E.
स्त्री, and निबन्धन conferring.

m. (-रः)
A libertine, a lover, a lecher.
E.
स्त्री a woman, and पर intent.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Reciprocal duty of husband and wife, or man and woman.
E.
स्त्री, and पुम् male, धर्म्म law.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Liked or loved by women.
m. (-यः)
The mango tree.
E.
स्त्री a female, and प्रिय dear.

m. (-मान्)
A husband, a wedded man.
E.
स्त्री, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-नं)
Pān, the mixture of betel-nut, Pān leaf, &c. chewed by the Hindus, and by women especially.
E.
स्त्री a woman, and रञ्जन delighting.

n. (-त्नं)
An excellent woman.
E.
स्त्री, and रत्न a gem.

n. (-ज्यं)
The kingdom of women, a country placed by some in the direction of Bhot.
E.
स्त्री, and राज्य kingdom.

n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Feminine gender.
2 Female organs.
E.
स्त्री, and लिङ्ग mark, &c.

n. (-शं)
Subjection to women.
E.
स्त्री, and वश subject.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Uxorious.
E.
स्त्री, and विधेय to be ruled.

m. (-हः)
Marrying a woman.
E.
स्त्री, and विवाह marriage.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Attended by women.
E.
स्त्री, and वृत surrounded.

n. (-णं)
Adultery, seduction.
E.
स्त्री, and संग्रहण taking.

n. (-भं)
An assembly of women, a number of females.
E.
स्त्री a woman, सभा- an assembly, neuter in this compound.

Marriage.
2

Connexion by marriage.
3 Relation or reference to women.
E.
स्त्री, and सम्बन्ध union.

f. (-वा)
Libertinism.
E.
स्त्री, and सेवा addiction to.

m. (-वः)
An attendant of the women's apartments, a eunuch.
E.
स्त्री female, स्वभाव nature.

f. (-त्या)
Murder of a woman.
E.
स्त्री, and हत्या killing.

m. (-न्ता)
A woman's murderer.
E.
स्त्री, and हन्तृ who kills.

n. (-णं)
Carrying off a woman, ravishment.
E.
स्त्री, and हरण taking.

m. (-री)
A ravisher, one who carries off a woman.
E.
स्त्री, and हृ to take, धिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
1 Female, feminine.
2 Suited to or good for women.
n. (-णं)
1

Womanhood.
2

The nature of woman.
E.
स्त्री a woman, and नञ् aff.

m. (वः)
One who lives by his wife's labours or prostitution.
E.
स्त्री, and आजीव subsistence.

n. (-नं)
Sexual intercourse.
E.
स्त्री, and अभिगमन going to.
